tagline.zh: 一份写给人类眼睛与 AI Agent 的瑞士现代主义数字刊物
tagline.en: A Swiss modernist digital publication authored for human eyes and AI agents

description.zh: 全静态、零构建、由 Agent 编排的双语个人刊物。探索 Agent 时代的界面、系统架构、信息设计与数字出版。
description.en: A fully static, zero-build, agent-authored bilingual publication exploring interfaces, system architecture, information design, and publishing in the agent era.

description.zh: 将网站同时设计为人类阅读界面与机器可消费的知识协议。
description.en: Designing websites simultaneously as human reading surfaces and machine-consumable knowledge protocols.

description.zh: 剥离多余控件与视觉噪音，让界面回归清晰意图与安静秩序。
description.en: Stripping away decorative chrome and control clutter so interfaces serve human intent quietly.

description.zh: 告别重型构建链与依赖腐烂，回归长期可持续的原生 Web 标准。
description.en: Leaving heavy build chains and dependency rot behind in favor of durable, native web standards.

description.zh: 以数学网格、清晰层级、发丝分割线与克制留白构建理性阅读秩序。
description.en: Building rational reading order through modular grids, typographic hierarchy, hairlines, and negative space.

description.zh: 以单一灵感源稿出发，由 Agent 编辑部产出同等文学与排印品质的双语版本。
description.en: Writing from a single source of thought while an agent editorial desk crafts idiomatic bilingual editions.

description.zh: 用概念拓扑与双向连接取代扁平时间线，沉淀可演进的个人知识网络。
description.en: Replacing flat chronological feeds with conceptual topology and bidirectional links.

description.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers Static Assets，保持当下零运维静态，同时预留内容协商与 MCP 接口。
description.en: Hosting on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets for zero-ops static delivery today with seamless upgrades to content negotiation and MCP tomorrow.

reading_time.zh: 7 分钟 · 含 2 组交互实验

zh.title: 双面万维网：同时写给人类眼睛与 AI Agent 的出版架构
zh.kicker: 封面特稿 · 交互实验
zh.deck: 当机器读者已经拥有纯净的文本通道，人类看到的网页就不该再向平庸妥协——它应该重新成为一件值得凝视与把玩的视觉作品。
zh.summary: 拆解“一文双面”的静态出版范式，内置「人类/Agent 透视实验室」与「瑞士网格字阶实验台」两套零依赖交互装置。

en.title: The Dual-Audience Web: Publishing for Human Eyes and AI Agents
en.deck: Once machine readers receive their own clean text channel, the web page humans visit no longer needs to flatten into plain text — it is free to become a tactile visual work again.
en.summary: An architectural blueprint for dual-surface static publishing, complete with a live Human/Agent Representation Inspector and a Swiss Modular Grid Workbench.

reading_time.zh: 6 分钟 · 含交互校准器

zh.title: 宁静界面：当交互从点击转向意图
zh.kicker: 交互特稿 · 界面设计
zh.deck: 软件工业花了二十年往屏幕上堆砌按钮、红点与带框卡片。当 Agent 接管繁琐操作，真正高级的界面终于可以学会闭嘴。
zh.summary: 剖析界面过度装饰的根源，并内置「界面信噪比校准器」交互装置，实时对比控件堆砌与克制意图界面之间的视觉熵值。

en.title: Quiet Interfaces: Designing Beyond the Click
en.deck: Software spent twenty years piling badges, borders, and status ribbons onto every screen. As agents absorb mechanical clicks, interfaces can finally learn the art of silence.
en.summary: An inquiry into chrome fatigue and intent-driven surfaces, complete with a live Interface Noise-to-Signal Calibrator.

reading_time.zh: 6 分钟 · 留白双击对照

zh.title: 双语即思考：Agent 时代的写作不再被单一语言围困
zh.deck: 传统国际化的本质是“把界面硬塞进翻译字典”；而 Agent 时代的双语出版，让每篇思考同时在中文的凝练与英文的精密中获得立体感。
zh.summary: 讨论中英双语写作如何反哺逻辑清晰度，并支持在段落左右留白处双击唤醒当前段落的英文对照版本。

en.title: Thinking in Stereo: Writing Beyond Monolingual Boundaries
en.deck: Legacy i18n reduced language to brittle key-value lookup tables. Agent-native bilingual publishing lets an idea resonate simultaneously in the compression of Chinese and the precision of English.
en.summary: Why maintaining idiomatic Chinese and English editions sharpens thought itself — featuring a margin double-click gesture that unfolds each paragraph's counterpart language in place.

zh.title: 十年之后依然可读：静态网页与数字资产的半衰期
zh.kicker: 专栏 · 系统长期主义
zh.deck: 绝大多数个人博客不是死于失去写作热情，而是死于一次失败的依赖升级。把文字与交互沉淀为标准 HTML 文件，是数字时代最朴素的抗衰法则。
zh.summary: 以数字出版物的半衰期为线索，对比动态栈、重型构建链与零依赖纯静态 HTML 在十年尺度下的维护成本与可迁移性。

en.title: Readable in Ten Years: Static HTML and the Half-Life of Digital Work
en.deck: Most personal sites do not die from a lack of ideas — they die from a broken dependency tree. Crystallizing writing and craft as plain standard HTML is the surest hedge against link rot and tooling churn.
en.summary: Measuring the half-life of personal publishing stacks across a ten-year horizon, from dynamic CMS databases to zero-dependency static HTML on the edge.

zh.title: 后模板时代：为什么个人出版物应该由 Agent 直接书写 HTML
zh.kicker: 创刊专栏 · 出版方法论
zh.deck: 传统静态博客框架是为了弥补人类写 HTML 的体力极限而生的妥协。当编写者变成 Agent，我们可以扔掉沉重的构建管线，拿回网页原本的表达自由。
zh.summary: 阐述 Tong's Information 的发刊哲学：如何通过秩序层与创意层分离，实现零框架、抗熵增、原生双语的静态出版工作流。

en.title: Beyond Templates: Why Personal Publishing Belongs to Agent-Authored HTML
en.deck: Traditional static site generators were an ergonomic compromise for human hands tired of writing HTML. With an agent at the desk, we can discard brittle build pipelines and reclaim the native medium of the web.
en.summary: The founding thesis of Tong's Information: separating structural order from creative layout to achieve a zero-framework, entropy-resistant, agent-bilingual static publication.
